description.value: The Fruitvale Pub & Grill is a laidback neighbourhood pub on historic Main Street in the Beaver Valley, known for hand-ground burgers made from premium beef and an open-concept kitchen where cyclists can watch their food being prepared. The pub offers a full menu of burgers, fries, ribs, and fresh greens alongside draft beer, classic cocktails, and a to-go cold beer and wine selection. It sits in the small community of Fruitvale in BC's Kootenay region, making it a potential resupply stop for riders touring the area.
